# Vendored BIOS binaries

These prebuilt BIOS images are bundled so OmniVM works with zero network
access:

- `seabios.bin`  — SeaBIOS (https://www.seabios.org), LGPLv3.
  Version: rel-1.16.2-0-gea1b7a0, as distributed with the v86 project
  (https://github.com/copy/v86). LGPLv3 requires the source to be available;
  obtain it from https://github.com/qemu/seabios or https://www.seabios.org.
- `vgabios.bin`  — VGABIOS (https://www.nongnu.org/vgabios), LGPLv2.1,
  as distributed with the v86 project.

They are redistributed here unmodified, solely as emulator ROM data.
